posts.author: mieymieyshaeyra236_
posts.text:
Personal branding focuses on an individual's reputation and identity, often emphasizing their values and expertise to build a loyal following. Product branding, on the other hand, centers on a specific product's features, benefits, and uniqueness to attract customers. The better choice depends on your goals: for personal influence, prioritize personal branding; for business growth, focus on product branding.
